shared.cloud_sync_privacy_body:
When cloud sync is enabled, your school-system password and Moodle token are encrypted and uploaded to the TigerDuck server, where they are used to periodically fetch Moodle assignments on your behalf and to sync timetable edits, assignment states, and settings across your devices.

You can disable cloud sync at any time. Disabling signs this device out and revokes its registration on the server (including push credentials); uploaded account credentials stay on the server only while other synced devices still use them. Local data is not affected.

TigerDuck è un assistente per il campus realizzato da un gruppo di studenti per risolvere risorse sparse, notifiche in ritardo e interfacce poco pratiche.

android.onboarding_flavor_fdroid_description:
Stai usando la versione F-Droid. Poiché la policy di F-Droid vieta dipendenze dai servizi Google (Firebase FCM, GMS, ecc.), le seguenti due funzionalità non sono disponibili in questa versione:

1. App companion per Wear OS
2. Notifiche push in tempo reale
